column2: Foolish, power-hungry $$ユダ$$, forgive us for disturbing the meal of such lovely ladies!
Y-you have said quite enough of that nonsense!!
You too were once a scholar who studied the $$大邪神$$ armor as my disciple...
Then surely you understand the true meaning of the power hidden within that armor...
You, of all people, should understand!
And I have finally found a clue to breaking this armor's $$封印$$...
Forgive me, but the $$大邪神$$ armor...
I will have it, no matter what!
$$ユダ$$! Since long ago, you have been a shallow man who could not help but
envy anyone stronger or more respected than yourself.
Your heart—and $$ルピルピ$$'s painful feelings...
That is precisely why I chose, of my own will, to remain in that prison until now!
